title: Border Patrol Laredo Sector: 'The Border Is Closed' in Message on Unlawful Entry
excerpt: U.S. Border Patrol Laredo Sector shared a message on November 20 saying its agents remain vigilant across mounted units, tactical teams, river patrols and checkpoint operations, and that the border is closed to unlawful entry.
content:
U.S. Border Patrol Laredo Sector shared a message on Thursday, November 20, saying its agents maintain vigilance across mounted units, tactical teams, river patrols and checkpoint operations to combat illegal immigration and protect the nation.

In the message, the sector said: “This is border security.”

The sector addressed people attempting unlawful entry directly, saying: “THE BORDER IS CLOSED. Anyone who enters illegally will be intercepted and the rule of law will be enforced without exception.”

The post was shared on the sector’s official Facebook page.

Source: U.S. Border Patrol Laredo Sector, Facebook, November 20, 2026.
